title: Very thin, pretty design, seem flimsy
text: Very thin, pretty design, seem flimsy. I bought these for use by a friend in Afghanistan so he would have an extra set. I washed them before sending them on to him and they are very, very thin. The fabric is soft and should be pretty cool to the skin in the summer heat, but these are definately not going to be warm in the winter months. The other concern is the flimsy stitching along the edges - one washing and I had to clip some threads that had come loose. Not a good sign. The bottom line is these sheets will be fine for a few months, long term use & laundering will tear them up pretty quickly. I won't buy them again.

description: Luxury and Elegance are inscribed with scrolls and chain links  in this At Home sheet set. It gives you the warmth and love we all need when heading to sleep.
